# Nick's Computer

> A personal blog about software engineering, technology, and things I find interesting.

## About

Nick is a software engineer currently empowering teams with surprisingly smart tools at Funnel.io and building dev tools as multipliers for coding agents. Previously at Klarna.

## Sections

- [Thoughts](https://nicksenap.github.io/thoughts): Blog posts about technology, programming, and ideas.
- [Works](https://nicksenap.github.io/works): Projects and tools.

## Blog Posts

- [My CLI got slow, so I fixed it](https://nicksenap.github.io/thoughts/cli-got-slow/): Spawning 400 git subprocesses made my CLI crawl. Deduping, threading, and caching brought it from 10 seconds to 200 milliseconds.

## Projects

- [Grove](https://github.com/nicksenap/grove): A CLI tool for managing git worktrees across multiple repos. One command, one branch, all your repos checked out and ready.
- [Paparazzi](https://github.com/nicksenap/paparazzi): A Chrome extension and MCP server that lets Claude Code see what's on your screen. Take screenshots, inspect the DOM, run JS, all from Claude Code.
